name: European continental club competition (2025–26)
author: BallGM
description: Twenty clubs, a 38-round double round robin, best-of-five quarter-finals and a single-game final four; no salary cap, no draft, an open market, FIBA game rules.

fidelity.detail: This league plays four 10-minute quarters; the match engine plays four 12-minute quarters, so per-game totals run about a fifth high. Rates (per possession, per 36 minutes, percentages) compare fairly.
The top eight qualify directly for the quarter-finals.

fidelity.rule: Final Four at a neutral venue
fidelity.detail: Semi-finals and final are single games, but the higher seed is treated as the home side.
Club spending is not limited; there is no cap of any kind in this preset.
Clubs play only this competition; the weekend domestic fixtures are not part of the calendar.
FIBA carries fourth-quarter team fouls into overtime; here overtime starts a fresh count, with the bonus from the fifth foul.
